title: Causes of hypothyroidism and clinical features
sec: Causes of hypothyroidism and clinical features · p905
guide: Anchor the iatrogenic, drug-induced, iodine-related and autoimmune buckets. Learn why lithium, amiodarone, IFN-α and ICIs can each unmask or cause hypothyroidism, and tie constitutional, cardiovascular, reproductive and neurological features to common clinical presentations.

title: Hashimoto thyroiditis and subclinical hypothyroidism
sec: Hashimoto thyroiditis and subclinical hypothyroidism · p906
guide: Distinguish Hashimoto by histology, antibodies and demographic. Frame subclinical hypothyroidism as a TSH-guided decision tree with pregnancy-specific and antibody-positive thresholds that override simple numeric cut-offs.

title: Complications and clinical pearls of hypothyroidism
sec: Complications and clinical pearls of hypothyroidism · p907
guide: Read myxoedema coma, Hashimoto encephalopathy and carpal-tunnel syndrome as the principal complications. Note the page's 'hypocholesterolaemia' label is at odds with the usual hypercholesterolaemia of hypothyroidism and should be flagged as an inconsistency.

title: Hypothyroidism management: levothyroxine and special populations
sec: Hypothyroidism management: levothyroxine and special populations · p908
guide: Levothyroxine is taken on an empty stomach with a 6–8 week TSH review after each dose change. Learn weight-based replacement in young adults, low-and-slow initiation in elderly cardiac patients and the 25–30% dose increase required in pregnancy.

title: Subclinical hypothyroidism, myxoedema coma and review
sec: Subclinical hypothyroidism, myxoedema coma and review · p909
guide: Recognise non-compliance as the most common cause of persistent abnormal TFTs and pursue IV levothyroxine plus hydrocortisone with passive rewarming for myxoedema coma. Combination T4/T3 therapy remains non-standard.
